decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - NOT LAWFUL - Planning Permission RequiredReason:The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 30 March 2009, the proposal as shown on the drawing submitted on 30 March 2009 and numbered LW/VP/1863/FD/01, 02, 05 and 06, and submitted on 7 May 2009 and numbered LW/VP/1863/FD/03 and 04 Rev A, was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:The development does not comply with the terms of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (as amended in 2008) as the roof pitch of the proposed two storey rear extension would not be the same roof pitch as the original dwellinghouse.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for a single storey rear extension, single storey side extension, first floor rear extension, hip to gable roof extension and rear roof extension to the dwellinghouse.
